capabilities: Sync Fieldy conversations into Markdown notes
Browse conversations and tasks in a side panel
Render conversation, task and stats dashboards in fieldy code blocks
Import full history and export to Markdown, JSON, CSV or text
Filter private conversations by keyword, speaker, place, template or time
disambiguation: Not a vault-sync tool: it pulls Fieldy conversations into notes and otherwise only reads from Fieldy.
extras: README covers installation and setup but points to a separate user guide and reference for the panel, dashboards, edited notes and troubleshooting. Mobile is untested, with support planned for 1.2. The README includes the author's Fieldy referral link ($30 off) and states the plugin is not affiliated with Fieldy.
problem: Fieldy conversations, tasks and transcripts live outside the vault, and copying them into Obsidian by hand is tedious and risks duplicates or overwritten edits.

relations.evidence: Import and synchronise your Fieldy conversations into clean, well-structured Markdown notes in Obsidian
Fieldy notes also work with Dataview, with ready-made queries one command away.
Fieldy tasks written in the Tasks plugin format inside notes (the panel already inserts them that way)

summary: Imports and syncs Fieldy conversations, tasks and transcripts into Markdown notes, with a side panel, dashboards and export.
